publication: Local experiment. No blog, PR, push or public deployment.
scope: Paged source-use cuts retain original native owners. Complete source-spine coverage and fresh closed-packet replay for one larger public packet are separate from per-call type observations, which remain unavailable there. Resident component bounds do not establish total heap use, compact global storage, semantic abstraction or comprehension.

derivation.scope: Paged topology preserves the earlier finite native observations; the larger source-only packet adds structural coverage without per-call typing or new kernel runs.

unit.scope: All earlier native ports retain addresses and contexts; actual large-packet cuts use bounded pages and refuse unobserved types. Numeric high-degree controls test rank/select arithmetic, not a million-call Lean proof or a full high-degree browser benchmark.

source.scope: All maximal application-spine occurrences in both roots of one published compiled packet, with exact ordered fields, source-use witnesses, reverse indices and unavailable per-call types. No new Lean kernel run, semantic dependence or corpus-wide completeness claim.

closedPacketReplay.scope: Fresh closed-packet kernel replay and negative controls. Source-spine types remain unobserved; dependency revision is cache attribution, not an independent dependency rebuild.

deliveryClosure.algorithm: Sorted reachable file path, tab, compressed SHA-256, newline. All decoded page hashes/ranges are checked by the closure walker and complete-source audit.
